card.summary: No signup. Run npx tunnelmole 3000 and get a public URL for your local server instantly. Open source, client and server, and self-hostable.

free_tier.stated: No signup. Run npx tunnelmole 3000 and get a public URL for your local server instantly. Open source, client and server, and self-hostable.

egress.terms: no quota published; the offer is an instant public https URL with no signup; ingress: http-only

record.binding_note: No byte quota is published and none is needed: an HTTP-only tunnel cannot carry a WireGuard datagram.
record.reliability_note: free service is a courtesy; the software is self-hostable which moves the cost to a VM
record.confidence_note: Page is short and states the shape plainly. Self-hosting the server would still be an HTTP terminator.

evidence.proved: 'With a public https url just a single command away' and 'No signup'

record.notes: Open-source tunneling client written in TypeScript. Provides public URLs for local HTTP servers.

extras.wg_detail: the product is an HTTPS URL issuer for a web server; no TCP or UDP forward is described
extras.volume_stated: no quota published; the offer is an instant public https URL with no signup
extras.transit_note: the Tunnelmole service carries the HTTPS traffic
